entities.summary: Arthur Kattendyke Strange David Archibald Gore, 8th Earl of Arran, styled Lord Arran, was a British columnist and politician who served as the Conservative whip in the House of Lords. He is known for leading the effort in the House of Lords to decriminalise male homosexuality in 1967.
